column3: How to Get Rejected By God

column5: God gives people up to more sin if they refuse to repent. This giving up results in sexual immorality and ultimately a debased mind that does all kinds of evil and gives approval to others who do evil.

Like the Jews, people who grew up in church know the Law of God. Yet they are condemned because even though they know God's Law, they do not practice it. Growing up with the Law makes no difference. Only those who perfectly obey the Law will be accepted by God. God plays no favorites; He holds everyone to the standard of perfect righteousness.

Hearing the Law is not enough; you must do the Law perfectly. Even those who have never heard the Law have the Law written on their hearts in their conscience. Our conscience shows us the standard of our Creator since He is the one who put it in our hearts, and when we violate our conscience, we reveal our rebellion against our Creator.

column3: Good People Need the Gospel Too
column5: Hypocrisy is seen when we who know the Law and even teach the Law to others do not obey it ourselves. We will always fall short of obeying the Law. Our only hope is an inward circumcision performed by the Spirit of God which wil result in obedience and a desire for approval from God instead of men.
God is always faithful and always just. He is righteous to judge sinners.
Mankind is universally sinful, defiantly sinful, and comprehesively sinful. We are an unrighteous people in desperate need of a righteousness outside of ourselves to be gifted to us.

column3: And Now for the Good News
column5: God gifts us a perfect righteousness that we receive through faith, not the works of the Law. Because we have the righteousness of Christ, we are declared right God's sight. God is right to do this because all of our sins have been transferred to Christ.
